text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, March 11 - CHITTAGONG - 26 Vessels in port of which 4 containers, 2 fertiliser, 6 general cargo, 4 food grain, 1 cement, 2 cement clinker, 7 under repairs. 26 Vessels due by 18/3 of which 10 containers, 1 fertiliser, 5 general cargo, 3 food grain, 1 rapeseed 1 cement, 1 tanker, 1 24 hours, 1 for repairs, 1 for scraping, 1 survey vessel. 3-4 Days berthing delay for general cargo vessels.

INDIA, March 11 - Bombay - No labour problems. Six vessels loading at berth, 18 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 4 vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 waiting to discharge, 2 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Berthing delays - Containers/general cargo - 1-2 days, bulkers - 5-6 days. Calcutta - Six vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 2 bunkering. 22 Vessels due (2 coal, 11 products tankers, 7 containers, 1 wood, 1 steel). Cochin - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 8 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 tug, 1 small vessel, 1 general cargo vessel at dry-dock. 1-2 Days berthing delay expected for new arrivals.

Chennai (Madras) - No labour problems. Nine vessels discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 dredger dry-docked. 40 Vessels due (13 general cargo, 5 coal, 12 containers, 4 fertiliser, 1 edible oil, 1 scrap, 1 sugar, 2 molasses, 1 iron ore) with the following delays, coal/coke 3-4 days, scrap 4-5 days, no delays for containers/iron ore, fertiliser/others 2-3 days. Mormugao - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 2 loading at anchorage, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge, 1 under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders. 10 Vessels due (8 ore, 1 mop, 1 cement) with 4-5 days delay expected for ore vessels, no delays for the others.

Kandla - Five vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge, 24 tankers. 15 Vessels due with 5-6 days delay expected. Mangalore - No labour problems. Six vessels loading/discharging at berth, 4 vessels awaiting berths, 1 under arrest, 9 due with 2-3 days delay expected. Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. One tanker/iron ore vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge. 5 Vessels due (2 food grain, 3 tankers/iron ore vessels), with no berthing delays expected. Paradip - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge. 9 Vessels due (4 coal, 4 iron, 1 oil) with 2-3 days berthing delay expected.

Tuticorin - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge, 1 under repair/dry-docked, 8 due with 2-3 days delay at present. Visakhatnam - Four vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchor to discharge at inner harbour berth, 20 due with 7-8 days delay expected.

MALAYSIA, March 12 - Port Kelang - North/south port, container/ro-ro berth - 8 Vessels berthed, 12 waiting with 4 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 due to berth 12/3, 4 waiting, 2 days waiting time expected. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 2 waiting with 2 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 2 days waiting time. West port container/ro-ro berth - 2 Vessels berthed, none waiting, no delays. Deep draft conventional wharf - 8 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 2 days waiting time. Cement bulk terminal - 1 Vessel berthed, none waiting, no delays. Liquid bulk terminal - No vessels, no delays.
MAURITIUS, March 11 - Port Louis - Labour working normally. Nine vessels berthed of which 2 loading/discharging containers, 7 discharging general cargo, no idle vessels, 13 due by 18/3.

PAKISTAN, March 10 - Karachi - Eight vessels loading at berth (rice/mol), 1 container vessel loading/discharging at berth. 11 Vessels discharging at berth (urea, dap, general cargo, sugar, phosphate, hsd). 4 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (rice, masses). 9 Vessels waiting to discharge (general cargo, containers, fertiliser, tankers, fuel oil). 5 Vessels awaiting orders, 7 due with following delays, general cargo/containers 1-2 days, rice loaders 24 hours, fertiliser vessels 15 days. Port Qasim - March 8 - One rice vessel loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth (wheat, project cargo, coal, fuel oil). 2 Rice vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 waiting to discharge (sugar, iron ore, fuel oil, palm oil).

SOUTH KOREA, March 11 - Inchon - 53 Vessels in port (39 berthed, 14 anchored) of which berthed, 8 general cargo, 5 containers, 3 logs, 3 cars, 3 steel, 2 coils, 2 corn, 2 plywood, 2 scrap, 1 h-beams, 1 raw sugar, 1 tapioca, 1 soda, 1 soymeal, 1 pig-iron, wheat, 1 talc, 1 copra. Vessels anchored, 2 general cargo, 2 pig-iron, 1 molasses, 1 corn, 1 containers, 1 coils, 1 ingots, 1 wheat, 1 cars, 1 steel billets, 1 ply-wood, 1 steel, approx. 1 days berthing delay expected at present. Busan - 151 Vessels in port (43 berthed, 108 anchored including 54 laid-up) of which berthed, 26 general cargo, 9 containers, 4 scrap, 4 coal. 54 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

Pohang - 23 Vessels in port (22 berthed, 1 anchored) of which discharging, 4 coils, 3 scrap, 1 coal, 1 iron ore, 1 pipes, 1 structures, 1 coke, 1 slab, 1 billets, 1 plant. 7 Steel vessels loading, 1 vessel awaiting berth, with approx. 1 days delay expected. Ulsan - 20 Vessels in port, all berthed, of which discharging, 1 feed meal, 1 asphalt in drums, 1 methanol, 1 base oil, 1 propylene, 1 raw sugar, 1 zinc concentrate, 1 wood-chips, 1 crude oil, 1 paraxylene, 1 corn. Vessels loading, 5 general cargo, 1 steel pipes, 1 diesel oil, 1 chemicals, 1 kocosol, no berthing delays expected. Masan - Five vessels in port, all berthed, of which discharging, 1 bananas, 1 steel scrap. Vessels loading, 1 machinery, 1 coaches, 1 general cargo, no berthing delays expected.

TAIWAN, March 7 - Keelung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain/coal 5 days, steel/iron ore 3 days. Kaohsiung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain/steel 1 day, iron/coal 2 days (CSC berths), coal/scrap 1 day (public berth). Taichung - Five vessels anchored. Berthing delays, iron ore/coal/scrap/steel 1 day, grain/others 1-2 days.
